tweets: Raigad — citadel of the Marathas, rising over 800 m above the Konkan plains. Its hilltop was built for siege: concealed granaries, stepped water cisterns, and multiple gated ramparts allowing a small garrison to hold out, then strike — the logic of ganimi kava, guerrilla war.

On 6 June 1674, Chhatrapati Shivaji was crowned here, founding an Ashtapradhan — council of eight ministers overseeing revenue, defence and justice. Within decades Maratha power reached from the Deccan to Delhi's gates. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history.
